one_sentence: The ten fundamental laws of physics are structurally identical to ten spiritual laws, differing only by a single asymmetry term encoding free will.
executive_summary: This document presents the Master Equation framework, claiming that the ten fundamental laws of physics (gravity, mass-energy, electromagnetism, strong force, thermodynamics, information, relativity, quantum mechanics, weak force, and coherence) have exact structural counterparts in the spiritual domain (grace, meaning, truth, love, moral entropy, Logos, relationship, faith, sin-decay, and Christ). Each physical law is shown to be identical to its spiritual analog except for one consistently placed asymmetry term that encodes agent choice—a degree of freedom physics lacks. The document provides substitution maps, the asymmetry table, and multiple mathematical forms (product, dynamic, ratio, and Lagrangian) to demonstrate the isomorphism. The conclusion is that the universe is architecturally designed with free will as the only structural difference between physical and spiritual reality.
short_summary: This document is the canonical presentation of the Master Equation, the central claim of the Theophysics Research Initiative. Key evidence includes the identical 192π³ denominator in Law 9, the unchanged Shannon entropy equation in Law 6, and the consistent pattern of one added term across all ten laws. This matters because it provides a mathematically rigorous framework for understanding the relationship between physical and spiritual reality, with free will as the only structural difference.
